why: Both land on the key's mailing-systems-plus-installed-base hedgehog, the point-of-sale exit and the same brutal facts, but Analysis 1 uses the exact profit-per-customer denominator and explicitly flags falling mail volume from electronic communication as the decline path. Analysis 2 has the punchier, more concrete verdict screen, but leans on a few more unflagged inferences and misses the mail-volume fade.
